name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts a Measured & Indicated resource of 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold (454 Moz AgEq), with a completed Preliminary Feasibility Study showing a US$494M after-tax NPV and 26% IRR. The company graduated to the TSX from the TSXV in February 2025 and is backed by shareholders including Eric Sprott and Kinross Gold.
